نتخايل (form VI)
# نَتَخَايَلُ (nataḵāyalu) /na.ta.xaː.ja.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَخَايَلَ (taḵāyala)
# نَتَخَايَلَ (nataḵāyala) /na.ta.xaː.ja.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَخَايَلَ (taḵāyala)
# نَتَخَايَلْ (nataḵāyal) /na.ta.xaː.jal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَخَايَلَ (taḵāyala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
